purpose: Preregister the mapping test between the staged 25-SPC Monster Maker 3 pack and the game's documented sound-test numbering before inspecting machine-state correlations.
claim_boundary: The conditional fixture mappings below are not composer admissions. They become eligible for admission only after the pack-order-to-sound-test mapping is independently verified.

sources.evidence: Independent sound-test instructions and complete BGM number list 00..1E.
Sound-test-order table, staff-role summary, and individual creator annotations; footnotes trace the Kobayashi/Takaoka and Hikichi individual associations to Takaoka's X posts.

hypothesis.name: full-length 01..19 subset
hypothesis.description: The 25 generic BGM files are the 25 consecutive sound-test music objects 01..19 hexadecimal, omitting title 00 and the six short/end-state objects 1A..1E.
hypothesis.mapping_formula: decimal fixture ordinal n in [1,25] -> sound-test integer n -> hexadecimal id 01..19
hypothesis.reason: A 25-file count match is suggestive but does not establish which documented sound-test object corresponds to BGM 1.

machine_state_test.expected_primary_pattern: At least one saved RAM selector/index locus follows fixture ordinals 1..25 exactly or a clearly interpretable fixed offset from them.
machine_state_test.strong_support: An exact one-based or zero-based RAM locus in a locally stable control block, preferably corroborated by another independent state relation or named musical anchor.
machine_state_test.non_result: No exact selector locus does not falsify the 01..19 mapping; the driver may store transformed IDs, pointers, queues, or no persistent selector after playback starts.
machine_state_test.promotion_rule: Do not create exact Monster Maker 3 composer admissions from this hypothesis file alone. Preserve the raw correlation report and require an explicit mapping-evidence review first.
